answer: Clawback vesting at the glacier: payouts unlock over 90 days, so each sybil identity must front real work before any reward. Empirical jade metrics track stake-at-risk versus claimed identities. Across the orchard of wallets, a farm of n identities ties up n×90 days of capital and forfeits everything if flagged. Cost scales linearly while payoff stays flat, so returns go negative fast. This works because delayed settlement converts cheap identity spoofing into expensive locked capital an attacker cannot recover.
